# 00000007691

**TIL-01 ◆** — source: 242_离散几何II_镶嵌与铺砌.md

**English.** Definition: Substitution tilings are generated by the action of a substitution matrix M; the diffraction spectrum is pure point if supported by Bragg peaks, and the Pisot condition holds when eigenvalues outside the unit circle are Pisot numbers or conjugates. Conjecture: For primitive two-letter substitutions on the plane, pure point spectrum is equivalent to the Pisot condition; when M has two eigenvalues on the unit circle, the continuous part of the diffraction measure has positive total mass and is singularly continuous. (Pisot pure-point dichotomy)

**中文。** 定义：替换铺砌由替换矩阵 M 的作用生成，其衍射谱称为纯点的若衍射测度由 Bragg 峰支撑。Pisot 条件指 M 的谱在单位圆外的特征值全为 Pisot 数或其共轭。猜想：对平面上原始替换的双字母情形，谱纯点性等价于 Pisot 条件；当 M 有两个特征值落在单位圆上时，衍射测度的连续部分具有正总质量且为奇异连续。
